description: UI layer: update staff concern review view with Progress Timeline card and Update Status form; update resident/SK concerns list view with expandable progress timeline per concern. Depends on FEAT-001 (controller must pass $progress and $row['progress'] data before views can render it).
steps: Update app/Views/dashboard/secretary/concern_review.php — extend $statusMap PHP array (around line 378 of the view) to add 'processing' => ['label'=>'Processing','class'=>'cr-status--processing','icon'=>'fa-spinner'] and 'ongoing' => ['label'=>'Ongoing','class'=>'cr-status--ongoing','icon'=>'fa-sync-alt'].

Update app/Views/dashboard/secretary/concern_review.php — add CSS for .cr-status--processing and .cr-status--ongoing in the <style> block after the existing .cr-status--dismissed rule: .cr-status--processing { background:#eef4ff; color:#1d5fb0; border:1px solid #c3d7f7; } .cr-status--ongoing { background:#f0f9ff; color:#0369a1; border:1px solid #bae6fd; }

Update app/Views/dashboard/secretary/concern_review.php — in the left column of .cr-wrap, after the closing of the concern-details .cr-card and before the left column's closing , insert the Progress Timeline card. The card renders $progress as a vertical timeline. Each entry shows: date formatted as 'M d, Y at g:i A', the status badge using $statusMap, the note text, and (if proof_path is set) a link to '/'.$entry['proof_path'] opening in a new tab. When $progress is empty show muted text 'No progress updates yet.'

Update app/Views/dashboard/secretary/concern_review.php — in the right sidebar column, after the closing of the Official Response .cr-card, add the Update Status form card. Only render this card when $c['status'] is not 'dismissed' and not 'resolved'. Form POSTs to '/'.$role.'/concern/update-status/'.(int)$c['id'] with enctype=multipart/form-data. Fields: status

Update app/Views/dashboard/sk/concerns.php — extend $statusMap inside the foreach loop (~line 185) to add 'processing' => ['clr-badge--approved','fa-spinner','Processing'] and 'ongoing' => ['clr-badge--approved','fa-sync-alt','Ongoing'].
Update app/Views/dashboard/sk/concerns.php — in the Status , after the cancel button endif, add a conditional 'N Updates' toggle button:

Update app/Views/dashboard/sk/concerns.php — immediately after each concern's , add a collapsible progress timeline . Inside render each $row['progress'] entry showing status label, date, note, and optional proof link. Close .

Update app/Views/dashboard/sk/concerns.php — in the <script> block at the bottom, add: function toggleProgress(id) { const row = document.getElementById('progress-' + id); if (row) row.style.display = row.style.display === 'none' ? 'table-row' : 'none'; }
acceptance_criteria: Visiting /secretary/concern/{id} for a pending concern shows both 'Progress Timeline' card (left column) and 'Update Status' card (right sidebar)
Visiting /secretary/concern/{id} for a dismissed concern does NOT show the Update Status card
Submitting the Update Status form redirects back with a success flash message
After submitting a status update with a note and optional file, the Progress Timeline card shows the new entry with the correct status badge, note text, and proof link
Status badges for 'processing' and 'ongoing' render with correct colours (blue variants, not green/orange/grey)
Visiting /resident/concerns or /sk/concerns for a user who has a concern with progress updates shows a 'N Updates' button in the status column
Clicking the 'N Updates' button expands the timeline row showing each progress entry
php -l on both view files reports no syntax errors
verification: Load http://localhost/enu/secretary/concerns in browser, open a concern, verify Progress Timeline and Update Status cards present
Submit an Update Status form (select 'processing', enter a note, optionally attach a file) — verify redirect with success and timeline entry appears
Load http://localhost/enu/resident/concerns — verify progress toggle button appears for concerns that have updates
findings: All 8 steps implemented and verified. (1) concern_review.php: $statusMap extended with 'processing' and 'ongoing'; CSS added for .cr-status--processing and .cr-status--ongoing plus .cr-timeline-* utility classes; Progress Timeline card inserted in left column after concern-details .cr-card using $progress variable; Update Status form card inserted in right column after Official Response .cr-card, conditionally hidden when $c['status'] is 'dismissed' or 'resolved'; form POSTs to /role/concern/update-status/id with multipart/form-data. (2) sk/concerns.php: $statusMap extended with 'processing' and 'ongoing'; toggle button added after cancel button endif, showing count of updates; collapsible <tr id='progress-{id}'> added immediately after each concern </tr> rendering each progress entry with badge, date, note, and optional proof link; toggleProgress() JS function added to script block. php -l passes on both files.
